units.bytes: u64 resident logical bytes at each scored step
units.compute: measured operations and wall nanoseconds per prediction/update

persistent_bytes_rule: Report total persistent allocations, including fixed readout and explicit-state baselines, separately; do not double-add it to B_adaptive.
feature_cache_rule: Offline feature cache is infrastructure and never counted as arm-accessible memory.
peak_rule: Report peak and time curve for each byte category, not only final size.
sweep_authority: Proposals only until a separate preregistered resource-sweep seal.
